shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md; ls -R .agents | head -50

cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R src; cat src/*; ls node_modules | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs | head; sed -n 1,200p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox ThemeProvider Card Flex Text 2>&1 | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|Provider" guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -15; for c in TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Card; do echo "=== $c"; ls components/$c* 2>/dev/null; done

ls components/controls; sed -n 1,200p components/controls/TextInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ======; grep -n "^#\|checked\|onUpdate\|content" components/Checkbox.md | head -30; echo =====; grep -n "type=\|loading\|width\|view" components/Button.md | head -20

sed -n '/## Properties/,$p' components/controls/PasswordInput.md | cut -c1-200 | head -30; grep -n "| type\|| width\|| loading\|| href\|| disabled" components/Button.md | cut -c1-200; grep -n "| theme\|| lang\|| rootClassName" guides/*.md | head -5; sed -n '/## Properties/,/^$/p' components/Card.md | head -5; grep -n "type=\|Card" components/Card.md | head -12; grep -n "^| *\(variant\|as\|color\)" components/Text.md | cut -c1-160

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && sed -n 185,200p docs/components/Button.md | cut -c1-150; sed -n 10,30p docs/components/Card.md; grep -rn "type?" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n "export" components/Provider/*.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Button/Button.d.ts | head -40; cat theme/Provider.d.ts | head -30

sed -i 's| spacing={{p: 6}}||; s|<Flex direction="column" gap={5}>|<Flex direction="column" gap="spacing-5" padding="spacing-6">|; s|<Flex direction="column" gap={4}>|<Flex direction="column" gap="spacing-4">|' src/App.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
